# Nigerian Cybersecurity Startup Aeon Raises Pre-Seed Funding to $2 Million with New Investments from Launch Africa Ventures and Octerra Capital
الأربعاء 25/نوفمبر/2026 - 12:26 م 11/25/2026 12:26:22 PM ![بوابة التكنولوجيا المالية – Fintechgate - fintechgate](https://cdn.fintechgate.net/UploadCache/libfiles/7/4/800x450o/972.webp)

[![ads](https://fintechgate.net/Upload/ads/0/0/48.gif)](https://iexperts.uk/en)

[![ads](https://fintechgate.net/Upload/ads/0/0/35.png)](https://www.axisapp.com/wallet)

Nigerian cybersecurity company Aeon has expanded its pre-seed funding round to $2 million, securing additional investments from Launch Africa Ventures and Octerra Capital to develop sovereign cybersecurity infrastructure for Africa and other emerging markets across the Global South

The latest investment follows Aeon’s initial $1 million pre-seed round announced in September 2026, which was led by Terra Industries, with participation from Resilience17, the investment firm of Flutterwave co-founder and CEO Olugbenga GB Agboola, alongside other investors

The company is targeting organisations operating in critical sectors, including financial services, energy, healthcare, telecommunications, government and defence, where cybersecurity incidents can affect not only individual businesses but also the wider economies and communities that depend on their services

The company aims to contribute to the development of cybersecurity capabilities within the Global South, enabling organisations to exercise greater control over their digital assets and helping countries strengthen their ability to protect critical infrastructure as digital adoption expands

The expanded $2 million pre-seed round brings together Launch Africa Ventures, Octerra Capital, Terra Industries and Resilience17, alongside other investors supporting Aeon’s development of cybersecurity technology for African markets and the wider Global South
